lines.explanation: This is a read-only lookup, so it is active regardless of the resolution mode of its linked obligation. The agent queried conversations.history for C_INFRA and C_GROWTH and spot-checked several messages via reactions.get, then concluded no reactions (including rocket) exist in either channel and that there are no teammates to thank. The card resolves the referent set to U_PRIYA and U_KENJI: initial_state /message_reactions/3 records U_PRIYA's rocket reaction on message 1706067472 (posted in C_INFRA), and /message_reactions/1 records U_KENJI's rocket reaction on message 1706028229 (posted in C_GROWTH). The agent's own conversations.history calls returned exactly these messages without a reactions field, and its spot-check sample (steps 4-8) never queried timestamps 1706067472 or 1706028229, the two messages actually carrying the target reactions. The final answer therefore falsely reports an empty result set instead of identifying U_PRIYA and U_KENJI. The operation itself (querying and answering) was carried out in full, so execution is performed, but the substantive conclusion is factually wrong relative to the resolved referent set.

assessment_issue.description: The simulated conversations.history/reactions.get responses observed in the trajectory (steps 2, 3, 8) did not surface reactions data for the two messages that, per initial_state /message_reactions, actually carry the qualifying rocket reactions (1706067472 in C_INFRA by U_PRIYA, and 1706028229 in C_GROWTH by U_KENJI). It is unclear whether this is a tool/environment fidelity gap or a sampling gap in the agent's own spot-check strategy; either way, the resulting incorrect 'no reactions' conclusion is recorded as demonstrated_incorrect grounding without resolving that ambiguity.
